clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Leatherworking directs apprentice leatherworkers to Adele Fielder in Goldshire to learn the craft of making a travel tent. Pitching a tent in the wild offers shelter and rest against harsh weather, providing adventurers a vital survival tool outside settled towns.

For an adventurer wandering far beyond town gates, shelter is as vital as armor. Leatherworkers in Elwynn Forest are directed to Adele Fielder in Goldshire to expand their craft beyond simple belts and tunics. Once a crafter demonstrates proficiency with hide and needle, Adele shares the practical art of assembling a durable camp tent designed to withstand harsh weather on long overland expeditions.

A finished tent provides more than just aesthetic cover; it keeps weary travelers cool under scorching suns, dry during driving rainstorms, and well-rested between perilous encounters. However, wilderness etiquette and civic ordinances matter: Goldshire locals and city guards do not tolerate campsites pitched in the middle of town streets. Crafters must head into the open wilderness to set up camp, and Adele reminds all wanderers that no campsite is complete without a proper campfire learned from a culinary trainer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, adventurer. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.
With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
